description: Utility functions for type checking, object manipulation, and environment detection used within the axios library.

methods.name: kindOfTest
methods.description: Returns a function to test if a value is of a specific kind (e.g., 'ArrayBuffer', 'Date').

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is an Array.

methods.name: isUndefined
methods.description: Checks if a value is undefined.

methods.name: isBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Buffer.

methods.name: isArrayBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a value is an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: isArrayBufferView
methods.description: Checks if a value is a view on an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a number.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is an object.

methods.name: isPlainObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain object.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Date.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a value is a File.

methods.name: isBlob
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Blob.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if a value is a function.

methods.name: isStream
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Stream.

methods.name: isURLSearchParams
methods.description: Checks if a value is a URLSearchParams object.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: isStandardBrowserEnv
methods.description: Detects if code is running in a standard browser environment.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Iterates over an array or object, invoking a callback for each item.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges multiple objects into a new object.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends an object by copying properties from another object.

methods.name: stripBOM
methods.description: Removes byte order marker from a string.

methods.name: inherits
methods.description: Sets up prototype inheritance between constructors.

methods.name: toFlatObject
methods.description: Flattens an object with deep prototype chain into a plain object.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified substring.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts array-like objects to arrays.

methods.name: isTypedArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is a typed array.

methods.name: forEachEntry
methods.description: Iterates over entries of an iterable object.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Returns all matches of a regex in a string.
